title: Research company websites
description: Discover metalworking businesses in a country or verify 1–10 supplied official websites.

urls.title: Official company website URLs
urls.description: 1–10 public HTTPS websites; no internal URLs or private data.

keywords.title: Relevant manufacturing keywords
keywords.description: Terms to match on public pages, e.g. metal fabrication, OEM, forging.

sales_pipeline.title: Enable HubSpot and proposal drafts
sales_pipeline.description: Sync qualified company records and store unsent proposals.

company_domain.title: Only this company domain
company_domain.description: Optional scope for a one-company trial, e.g. example.com.

discovery_country.title: Discover metalworking businesses by country
discovery_country.description: Optional two-letter uppercase country code, for example LT. Leave URLs empty for discovery.
